verdict.rationale: Runloop is a sandbox and infrastructure platform for running users' own AI agents, so a built-in assistant is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence documents hosting and deploying agents (Agents API, agent mounts), Cursor rules files, and an MCP server so external assistants can work with Runloop. None of these is a native in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to; they are adjacent building blocks or integrations, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
